wlc: כִּי־נָשְׂאוּ מִבְּנֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם וְהִתְעָרְבוּ זֶרַע הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְיַד הַשָּׂרִים וְהַסְּגָנִים הָיְתָה בַּמַּעַל הַזֶּה רִאשׁוֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ αὐλισθεὶς ἐκεῖ ἄρτου οὐκ ἐγεύσατο οὐδὲ ὕδωρ ἔπιεν, πενθῶν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀνομιῶν τῶν μεγάλων τοῦ πλήθους.
vulg: tulerunt enim de filiabus eorum sibi et filiis suis et commiscuerunt semen sanctum cum populis terrarum manus etiam principum et magistratuum fuit in transgressione hac prima
clem: tulerunt enim de filiabus eorum sibi et filiis suis, et commiscuerunt semen sanctum cum populis terrarum: manus etiam principum et magistratuum fuit in transgressione hac prima.
kjv: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.

wlc: וּכְשָׁמְעִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה קָרַעְתִּי אֶת־בִּגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶמְרְטָה מִשְּׂעַר רֹאשִׁי וּזְקָנִי וָאֵשְׁבָה מְשׁוֹמֵם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγένετο κήρυγμα ἐν ὁλῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ πᾶσι τοῖς ἐκ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας, συναχθῆναι εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ·
vulg: cumque audissem sermonem istum scidi pallium meum et tunicam et evelli capillos capitis mei et barbae et sedi maerens
clem: Cumque audissem sermonem istum, scidi pallium meum et tunicam, et evelli capillos capitis mei et barb, et sedi mrens.
kjv: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.

wlc: וְאֵלַי יֵאָסְפוּ כֹּל חָרֵד בְּדִבְרֵי אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל מַעַל הַגּוֹלָה וַאֲנִי יֹשֵׁב מְשׁוֹמֵם עַד לְמִנְחַת הָעָרֶב ׃
lxx: καἰ ὅσοι ἅν μὴ ἀπαντἠσουσιν ἐν δυσὶν ἢ τρισὶν ἡμέραις κατὰ τὸ κρίμα τῶν προκαθημένων πρεσβυτέρων, ἀνιερωθήσονται τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἀλλοτριωθήσεται ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας.
vulg: convenerunt autem ad me omnes qui timebant verbum Dei Israhel pro transgressione eorum qui de captivitate venerant et ego sedebam tristis usque ad sacrificium vespertinum
clem: Convenerunt autem ad me omnes qui timebant verbum Dei Isral, pro transgressione eorum qui de captivitate venerant, et ego sedebam tristis usque ad sacrificium vespertinum:
kjv: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.

wlc: וּבְמִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב קַמְתִּי מִתַּעֲנִיתִי וּבְקָרְעִי בִגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶכְרְעָה עַל־בִּרְכַּי וָאֶפְרְשָׂה כַפַּי אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἐπισυνήχθησαν οἱ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα καὶ Βενιαμεὶν ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ· οὗτος ὁ μὴν ἔνατος τῇ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνός.
vulg: et in sacrificio vespertino surrexi de adflictione mea et scisso pallio et tunica curvavi genua mea et expandi manus meas ad Dominum Deum meum
clem: et in sacrificio vespertino, surrexi de afflictione mea, et scisso pallio et tunica, curvavi genua mea, et expandi manus meas ad Dominum Deum meum.
kjv: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the Lord my God,

wlc: וָאֹמְרָה אֱלֹהַי בֹּשְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַמְתִּי לְהָרִים אֱלֹהַי פָּנַי אֵלֶיךָ כִּי עֲוֹנֹתֵינוּ רָבוּ לְמַעְלָה רֹּאשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵנוּ גָדְלָה עַד לַשָּׁמָיִם ׃
lxx: καὶ συνεκάθισαν πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἐν τῇ εὐρυχώρῳ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τρέμοντες τὸν ἐνεστῶτα χειμῶνα.
vulg: et dixi Deus meus confundor et erubesco levare Deus meus faciem meam ad te quoniam iniquitates nostrae multiplicatae sunt super caput et delicta nostra creverunt usque in caelum
clem: Et dixi: Deus meus, confundor et erubesco levare faciem meam ad te: quoniam iniquitates nostr multiplicat sunt super caput nostrum, et delicta nostra creverunt usque ad clum,
kjv: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

wlc: מִימֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּאַשְׁמָה גְדֹלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבַעֲוֹנֹתֵינוּ נִתַּנּוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מְלָכֵינוּ כֹהֲנֵינוּ בְּיַד מַלְכֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת בַּחֶרֶב בַּשְּׁבִי וּבַבִּזָּה וּבְבֹשֶׁת פָּנִים כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀναστὰς Ἐσρας εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς ἠνομήσατε καὶ συνοικήσατε γυναιξὶν ἀλλογενέσιν, προσθεῖναι ἁμαρτίαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: a diebus patrum nostrorum sed et nos ipsi peccavimus granditer usque ad diem hanc et in iniquitatibus nostris traditi sumus ipsi et reges nostri et sacerdotes nostri in manum regum terrarum in gladium in captivitatem in rapinam et in confusionem vultus sicut et die hac
clem: a diebus patrum nostrorum: sed et nos ipsi peccavimus graviter usque ad diem hanc, et in iniquitatibus nostris traditi sumus ipsi, et reges nostri, et sacerdotes nostri, in manum regum terrarum, et in gladium, et in captivitatem, et in rapinam, et in confusionem vultus, sicut et die hac.
kjv: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

wlc: וְעַתָּה כִּמְעַט־רֶגַע הָיְתָה תְחִנָּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְהַשְׁאִיר לָנוּ פְּלֵיטָה וְלָתֶת־לָנוּ יָתֵד בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ לְהָאִיר עֵינֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּלְתִתֵּנוּ מִחְיָה מְעַט בְּעַבְדֻתֵנוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν δότε ὁμολογίαν δόξαν τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν,
vulg: et nunc quasi parum et ad momentum facta est deprecatio nostra apud Dominum Deum nostrum ut dimitterentur nobis reliquiae et daretur paxillus in loco sancto eius et inluminaret oculos nostros Deus noster et daret nobis vitam modicam in servitute nostra
clem: Et nunc quasi parum et ad momentum facta est deprecatio nostra apud Dominum Deum nostrum, ut dimitterentur nobis reliqui, et daretur nobis paxillus in loco sancto ejus, et illuminaret oculos nostros Deus noster, et daret nobis vitam modicam in servitute nostra:
kjv: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

wlc: כִּי־עֲבָדִים אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעַבְדֻתֵנוּ לֹא עֲזָבָנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיַּט־עָלֵינוּ חֶסֶד לִפְנֵי מַלְכֵי פָרַס לָתֶת־לָנוּ מִחְיָה לְרוֹמֵם אֶת־בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּלְהַעֲמִיד אֶת־חָרְבֹתָיו וְלָתֶת־לָנוּ גָדֵר בִּיהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ποιήσατε τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ καὶ χωρίσθητε ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλογενῶν.
vulg: quia servi sumus et in servitute nostra non dereliquit nos Deus noster et inclinavit super nos misericordiam coram rege Persarum ut daret nobis vitam et sublimaret domum Dei nostri et extrueret solitudines eius et daret nobis sepem in Iuda et in Hierusalem
clem: quia servi sumus, et in servitute nostra non dereliquit nos Deus noster, sed inclinavit super nos misericordiam coram rege Persarum, ut daret nobis vitam, et sublimaret domum Dei nostri, et exstrueret solitudines ejus, et daret nobis sepem in Juda et Jerusalem.
kjv: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

wlc: וְעַתָּה מַה־נֹּאמַר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת כִּי עָזַבְנוּ מִצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐφώνησαν πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος καὶ εἶπον μεγάλῃ τῇ φωνῇ Οὕτως ὡς εἴρηκας ποιήσομεν.
vulg: et nunc quid dicemus Deus noster post haec quia dereliquimus mandata tua
clem: Et nunc quid dicemus, Deus noster, post hc? Quia dereliquimus mandata tua,
kjv: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

wlc: אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ בְּיַד עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים לְרִשְׁתָּהּ אֶרֶץ נִדָּה הִיא בְּנִדַּת עַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת בְּתוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר מִלְאוּהָ מִפֶּה אֶל־פֶּה בְּטֻמְאָתָם ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ τὸ πλῆθος πολὺ καὶ ὥρα χειμερινή, καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύσομεν στῆναι αἴθριοι καὶ οὐχ εὕρομεν· καὶ τὸ ἔργον ἡμῖν οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμέρας μιᾶς οὐδὲ δύο, ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ ἡμάρτομεν ἐν τούτοις.
vulg: quae praecepisti in manu servorum tuorum prophetarum dicens terram ad quam vos ingredimini ut possideatis eam terra inmunda est iuxta inmunditiam populorum ceterarumque terrarum abominationibus eorum qui repleverunt eam ab ore usque ad os in coinquinatione sua
clem: qu prcepisti in manu servorum tuorum prophetarum, dicens: Terra, ad quam vos ingredimini ut possideatis eam, terra immunda est juxta immunditiam populorum, ceterarumque terrarum, abominationibus eorum qui repleverunt eam ab ore usque ad os in coinquinatione sua.
kjv: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

wlc: וְעַתָּה בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם אַל־תִּתְּנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם אַל־תִּשְׂאוּ לִבְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא־תִדְרְשׁוּ שְׁלֹמָם וְטוֹבָתָם עַד־עוֹלָם לְמַעַן תֶּחֶזְקוּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֶת־טוּב הָאָרֶץ וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם לִבְנֵיכֶם עַד־עוֹלָם ׃
lxx: στήτωσαν δὲ οἱ προηγούμενοι τοῦ πλήθους, καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐκ τῶν κατοικιῶν ἡμῶν ὅσοι ἔχουσιν γυναῖκας ἀλλογενεῖς (13)παραγενηθήτωσαν λαβόντες χρόνον·
vulg: nunc ergo filias vestras ne detis filiis eorum et filias eorum non accipiatis filiis vestris et non quaeratis pacem eorum et prosperitatem eorum usque in aeternum ut confortemini et comedatis quae bona sunt terrae et heredes habeatis filios vestros usque in saeculum
clem: Nunc ergo filias vestras ne detis filiis eorum, et filias eorum ne accipiatis filiis vestris, et non quratis pacem eorum et prosperitatem eorum usque in ternum: ut confortemini, et comedatis qu bona sunt terr, et hredes habeatis filios vestros usque in sculum.
kjv: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

wlc: וְאַחֲרֵי כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂינוּ הָרָעִים וּבְאַשְׁמָתֵנוּ הַגְּדֹלָה כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ חָשַׂכְתָּ לְמַטָּה מֵעֲוֹנֵנוּ וְנָתַתָּה לָּנוּ פְּלֵיטָה כָּזֹאת ׃
lxx: ἑκάστου τόπου τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς κριτάς, ἕως τοῦ λῦσαι τὴν ὀργὴν Κυρίου ἀφʼ ἡμῶν τοῦ πράγματος τούτου.
vulg: et post omnia quae venerunt super nos in operibus nostris pessimis et in delicto nostro magno quia tu Deus noster liberasti nos de iniquitate nostra et dedisti nobis salutem sicut est hodie
clem: Et post omnia qu venerunt super nos in operibus nostris pessimis, et in delicto nostro magno, quia tu, Deus noster, liberasti nos de iniquitate nostra, et dedisti nobis salutem sicut est hodie,
kjv: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;

wlc: הֲנָשׁוּב לְהָפֵר מִצְוֹתֶיךָ וּלְהִתְחַתֵּן בְּעַמֵּי הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֲלוֹא תֶאֱנַף־בָּנוּ עַד־כַּלֵּה לְאֵין שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה ׃ פ
lxx: Ἰνάθας Ἀζαήλου καὶ Ἑζείας Θοκάνου ἐπεδέξαντο κατὰ ταῦτα, καὶ Μοσόλλαμος καὶ Λευεὶς καὶ Σαββαταῖος συνεβράβευσαν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: ut non converteremur et irrita faceremus mandata tua neque matrimonia iungeremus cum populis abominationum istarum numquid iratus es nobis usque ad consummationem ne dimitteres nobis reliquias et salutem
clem: ut non converteremur, et irrita faceremus mandata tua, neque matrimonia jungeremus cum populis abominationum istarum. Numquid iratus es nobis usque ad consummationem, ne dimitteres nobis reliquias ad salutem?
kjv: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל צַדִּיק אַתָּה כִּי־נִשְׁאַרְנוּ פְלֵיטָה כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַשְׁמָתֵינוּ כִּי אֵין לַעֲמוֹד לְפָנֶיךָ עַל־זֹאת ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐποί ησαν κατὰ πάντα ταῦτα οἱ ἐκ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας.
vulg: Domine Deus Israhel iustus tu quoniam derelicti sumus qui salvaremur sicut die hac ecce coram te sumus in delicto nostro non enim stari potest coram te super hoc
clem: Domine Deus Isral, justus es tu: quoniam derelicti sumus, qui salvaremur sicut die hac. Ecce coram te sumus in delicto nostro: non enim stari potest coram te super hoc.
kjv: O Lord God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.

lxx: Καὶ ἐπελέξατο αὐτῷ Ἐσρας ὁ ἱερεὺς ἄνδρας ἡγουμένους τῶν πατριῶν αὐτῶν πάντας κατʼ ὄνομα, καὶ συνεκλείσθησαν τῇ νουμηνίᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ δεκάτου ἐτάσαι τὸ πρᾶγμα.
καὶ ἤχθη ἐπὶ πέρας τὰ κατὰ τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς ἐπισυναχθέντας γυναῖκας ἀλλογενεῖς ἕως τῆς νουμηνίας τοῦ πρώτου μηνός.
καὶ εὑρέθησαν τῶν ἱερέων οἱ ἐπισυναχθέντες ἀλλογενεῖς γυναῖκας ἔχοντες
ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἰωσεδὲκ καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ Μαεήλας καὶ Ἐλεάζαρος καὶ Ἰώριβος καὶ Ἰώδανος·
καὶ ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐκβαλεῖν τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν, καὶ εἰς ἐξιλασμὸν κριοὺς ὑπέρ τῆς ἀγνοίας αὐτῶν·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἐμήρ, Ἁνανίας καὶ Ζαβδαῖος καὶ Μάνης καὶ Θαμαῖος καὶ Ἰερεὴλ καὶ Ἀζαρίας·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Φαισούρ, Ἐλιωναίς, Ἀσσείας, Ἰσμάηλος καὶ Ναθαναῆλος καὶ Ὠκαίληδος καὶ Σάλθας·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν Λευειτῶν, Ἰώζαβδος καὶ Σενσεὶς καὶ Κῶνος, οὗτος Καλειταίς, καὶ Παθαῖος· καὶ Ὠούδας καὶ Ἰωανᾶς,
ἐκ τῶν ἱεροψαλτῶν Ἐλιάσεβος, Βάκχουρος,
ἐκ τῶν θυρωρῶν Σάλλουμος καὶ Τολβάνης·
ἐκ τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Φορός, Ἰερμὰ καὶ Ἰεζείας καὶ Μελχείας καὶ Μίληλος καὶ Ἐλεάζαρος καὶ Ἁσεβείας καὶ Βανναίας·
ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἠλά, καὶ Ματὰν καὶ Ζαχαρίας. Ἰεζόρικλος καὶ Ὠαβδεῖος καὶ Ἰερεμὼθ καὶ Ἀηδείας·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ζαμόθ, Ἐλιαδᾶς, Ἐλειάσειμος, Ὀθονίας, Ἰαρειμὼθ καὶ Σάβαθος καὶ Ζεραλίας·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Βηβαί, Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀνανίας καὶ Ζάβδος καὶ Ἐμαθθίς·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Μανί, Ὤλαμος, Μάμουχος Ἰεδαῖος, Ἰάσουβος καὶ Ἀσάηλος καὶ Ἰερεμώθ·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἀδδείν, Λάθος καὶ Μοοσσείας, Λακκοῦνος καὶ Ναῖδος, καὶ Βεσκασπασμὺς καὶ Σεσθὴλ καὶ Βαλνοῦς καὶ Μανασσήας·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἁννάν, Ἐλιωδᾶς καὶ Ἀσαίας καὶ Μελχείας καὶ Σαββαίας καὶ Σίμων Χοσάμαος·
καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἁσόμ, Μαλτανναῖος καὶ Ματταθίας καὶ Σαβανναιοῦς καὶ Ἐλειφαλὰτ καὶ Μανασσὴ καὶ Σεμεεί·

καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Βαανεί, Ἰερεμίας, Μομδεῖος, Μάηρος, Ἰουνά, Μαμδαὶ καὶ Πεδίας καὶ Ἀνως, Καραβασειὼν καὶ Ἐνάσειβος καὶ Μαμτάναιμος, Ἐλιασείς, Βαννούς, Ἐδιαλείς, Σομεείς, Σελεμίας, Ναθανίας· καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἐζωρά, Σεσεἰς, Ἐζρεἰλ, Ἀζάηλος, Σάματος. Ζαμβρεί, Φόσηπος·
ἐκ τῶν Ὀομά, Ζειτίας, Ζαβαδαίας, Ἠδός, Οὐήλ, Βαναίας.
πάντες οὗτοι συνῷκησαν γυναιξὶν ἀλλογενέσιν, καὶ ἀπέλυσαν αὐτὰς σὺν τέκνοις.
Καὶ κατῴκησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται καὶ οἱ ἐκ τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ νουμηνίᾳ τοῦ ἑβδόμου μηνός, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν ταῖς κατοικίαις αὐτῶν.
Καὶ συνήχθη πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐπὶ τὸ εὐρύχωρον τοῦ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς ἱεροῦ πυλῶνος,
καὶ εἶπεν Ἐσρᾳ τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ ἀναγνώστῃ κομίσαι τὸν νόμον Μωσέως τὸν παραδοθέντα ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
καὶ ἐκόμισεν Ἔσρας ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς τὸν νόμον παντὶ τῷ πλήθει ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως γυναικὸς καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἱερεῦσι, ἀκοῦσαι τὸν νόμον, νουμηνίᾳ τοῦ ἑβδόμου μηνός·
καὶ ἀνεγίνωσκεν ἐν τῷ πρὸ τοῦ ἱεροῦ πυλῶνος εὐρυχώρου ἀπὸ ὄρθρου ἕως μεσημβρινοῦ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνδρῶν καὶ γυναικῶν· καὶ ἐπέδωκαν πάντα τὸν νοῦν εἰς τὸν νόμον.
καὶ ἔστη Ἔσρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἀναγνώστης τοῦ νόμου ἐπὶ τοῦ ξυλίνοῦ νοῦ βήματος τοῦ κατασ κευασθέντος·
καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτῷ Ματταθίας, Σαμμού, Ἀνανίας, Ἀζαρίας, Οὐρείας, Ἐζεκίας, Βαάλσαμος ἐκ δεξιῶν.
καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων Φαλαδαῖος, Μεισαήλ, Μελχείας, Λωθάσουβος, Ναβαρείας, Ζαχαρίας.
καὶ ἀναλαβὼν Ἔσρας τὸ βιβλίον τοῦ πλήθους ἐνώπιον, προεκάθητο γὰρ ἐπιδόξως ἐνώπιον πάντων,
καὶ ἐν τῷ λῦσαι τὸν νόμον πάντες ὀρθοὶ ἔστησαν· καὶ εὐλόγησεν Ἀζαρίας τῷ ὑψίστῳ θεῷ Παντοκράτορι,
καὶ ἐφώνησεν πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος Ἀμήν, ἀμήν· καὶ ἄραντες ἄνω τὰς χεῖρας προσπεσόντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν προσεκύνησαν τῷ θεῷ.

Ἰησοῦς καὶ Ἀννιοὺθ καὶ Σαραβίας, Ἰάδεινος, Ἰαρσούβοος, Ἀβταῖος, Aὑταίας, Μαιάννας καὶ Καλείτας, Ἀζαρίας, Κατέθζαβδος, Ἅννιας, Φαλίας, οἱ Λευεῖται, (49)ἐδίδασκον τὸν νόμον Κυρίου, καὶ πρὸς τὸ πλῆθος ἀνεγίνωσκον τὸν νόμον τοῖ κυρίου, ἐμφυσιοῦντες ἅμα τὴν ἀνάγνωσιν.
Καὶ εἶπεν Ἀτταρατὴ Ἔσρᾳ τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ καὶ ἀναγνώστῃ καὶ τοῖς Λευείταις τοῖς διδάσκουσι τὸ πλῆθος ἐπὶ πάντας
Ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ἐστὶν ἁγία τῷ κυρίῳ· καὶ πάντες ἔκλαιον ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαι τὸν νόμον·
βαδίσαντες οὖν φάγετε λιπάσματα καὶ ἀποστείλατε ἀποστολὰς τοῖς μὴ ἔχουσιν.
ἁγία γὰρ ἡ ἡμέρα τῷ κυρίη, καὶ μὴ λυπεῖσθε· ὁ γὰρ κύριος δοξάσει ὑμᾶς.
καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἐκέλευον τῷ δήμῳ πάντα λέγοντες Ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ἁγία, μὴ λυπεῖσθε.
καὶ ᾤχοντο πάντες φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν καὶ εὐφραίνεσθαι, καὶ δοῦναι ἀποστολὰς τοῖς μὴ ἔχουσιν, καὶ εὐφρανθῆναι μεγάλως·
ὅτι καὶ ἐνεφυσιώθησαν ἐν τοῖς ῥήμασιν οἷς ἐδιδάχθησαν. καὶ ἐπισυνήχθησαν.

wlc: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּל עֶזְרָא וּכְהִתְוַדֹּתוֹ בֹּכֶה וּמִתְנַפֵּל לִפְנֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים נִקְבְּצוּ אֵלָיו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל קָהָל רַב־מְאֹד אֲנָשִׁים וְנָשִׁים וִילָדִים כִּי־בָכוּ הָעָם הַרְבֵּה־בֶכֶה ׃ ס
vulg: sic ergo orante Ezra et inplorante eo et flente et iacente ante templum Dei collectus est ad eum de Israhel coetus grandis nimis virorum et mulierum puerorumque et flevit populus multo fletu
clem: Sic ergo orante Esdra, et implorante eo et flente, et jacente ante templum Dei, collectus est ad eum de Isral ctus grandis nimis virorum et mulierum et puerorum, et flevit populus fletu multo.
kjv: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

wlc: וַיַּעַן שְׁכַנְיָה בֶן־יְחִיאֵל מִבְּנֵי עוֹלָם וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֶזְרָא אֲנַחְנוּ מָעַלְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵינוּ וַנֹּשֶׁב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְעַתָּה יֵשׁ־מִקְוֶה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־זֹאת ׃
vulg: et respondit Sechenia filius Iehihel de filiis Helam et dixit Ezrae nos praevaricati sumus in Deum nostrum et duximus uxores alienigenas de populis terrae et nunc si est paenitentia Israhel super hoc
clem: Et respondit Sechenias filius Jehiel de filiis lam, et dixit Esdr: Nos prvaricati sumus in Deum nostrum, et duximus uxores alienigenas de populis terr: et nunc, si est pnitentia in Isral super hoc,
kjv: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

wlc: וְעַתָּה נִכְרָת־בְּרִית לֵאלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִיא כָל־נָשִׁים וְהַנּוֹלָד מֵהֶם בַּעֲצַת אֲדֹנָי וְהַחֲרֵדִים בְּמִצְוַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָה יֵעָשֶׂה ׃
vulg: percutiamus foedus cum Deo nostro ut proiciamus universas uxores et eos qui de his nati sunt iuxta voluntatem Domini et eorum qui timent praeceptum Dei nostri secundum legem fiat
clem: percutiamus fdus cum Domino Deo nostro, ut projiciamus universas uxores, et eos qui de his nati sunt, juxta voluntatem Domini, et eorum qui timent prceptum Domini Dei nostri: secundum legem fiat.
kjv: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

wlc: קוּם כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר וַאֲנַחְנוּ עִמָּךְ חֲזַק וַעֲשֵׂה ׃ פ
vulg: surge tuum est decernere nosque erimus tecum confortare et fac
clem: Surge, tuum est decernere, nosque erimus tecum: confortare, et fac.
kjv: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.

wlc: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא וַיַּשְׁבַּע אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּשָּׁבֵעוּ ׃
vulg: surrexit ergo Ezras et adiuravit principes sacerdotum Levitarum et omnem Israhel ut facerent secundum verbum hoc et iuraverunt
clem: Surrexit ergo Esdras, et adjuravit principes sacerdotum et Levitarum, et omnem Isral, ut facerent secundum verbum hoc: et juraverunt.
kjv: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

wlc: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא מִלִּפְנֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־לִשְׁכַּת יְהוֹחָנָן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם לֶחֶם לֹא־אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא־שָׁתָה כִּי מִתְאַבֵּל עַל־מַעַל הַגּוֹלָה ׃ ס
vulg: et surrexit Ezras ante domum Dei et abiit ad cubiculum Iohanan filii Eliasib et ingressus est illuc panem non comedit et aquam non bibit lugebat enim in transgressione eorum qui de captivitate venerant
clem: Et surrexit Esdras ante domum Dei, et abiit ad cubiculum Johanan filii Eliasib, et ingressus est illuc: panem non comedit, et aquam non bibit: lugebat enim transgressionem eorum, qui venerant de captivitate.
kjv: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

wlc: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בִּיהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִַם לְכֹל בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה לְהִקָּבֵץ יְרוּשָׁלִָם ׃
vulg: et missa est vox in Iuda et in Hierusalem omnibus filiis transmigrationis ut congregarentur in Hierusalem
clem: Et missa est vox in Juda et in Jerusalem omnibus filiis transmigrationis, ut congregarentur in Jerusalem:
kjv: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָבוֹא לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים כַּעֲצַת הַשָּׂרִים וְהַזְּקֵנִים יָחֳרַם כָּל־רְכוּשׁוֹ וְהוּא יִבָּדֵל מִקְּהַל הַגּוֹלָה ׃ ס
vulg: et omnis qui non venerit in tribus diebus iuxta consilium principum et seniorum auferetur universa substantia eius et ipse abicietur de coetu transmigrationis
clem: et omnis qui non venerit in tribus diebus juxta consilium principum et seniorum, auferetur universa substantia ejus, et ipse abjicietur de ctu transmigrationis.
kjv: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

wlc: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן יְרוּשָׁלַםִ לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים הוּא חֹדֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ כָל־הָעָם בִּרְחוֹב בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים מַרְעִידִים עַל־הַדָּבָר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִים ׃ פ
vulg: convenerunt igitur omnes viri Iuda et Beniamin in Hierusalem tribus diebus ipse est mensis nonus vicesimo die mensis et sedit omnis populus in platea domus Dei trementes pro peccato et pluviis
clem: Convenerunt igitur omnes viri Juda et Benjamin in Jerusalem tribus diebus: ipse est mensis nonus, vigesimo die mensis: et sedit omnis populus in platea domus Dei, trementes pro peccato, et pluviis.
kjv: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

wlc: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם מְעַלְתֶּם וַתֹּשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת לְהוֹסִיף עַל־אַשְׁמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
vulg: et surrexit Ezras sacerdos et dixit ad eos vos transgressi estis et duxistis uxores alienigenas ut adderetis super delictum Israhel
clem: Et surrexit Esdras sacerdos, et dixit ad eos: Vos transgressi estis, et duxistis uxores alienigenas, ut adderetis super delictum Isral.
kjv: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

wlc: וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ תוֹדָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַעֲשׂוּ רְצוֹנוֹ וְהִבָּדְלוּ מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וּמִן־הַנָּשִׁים הַנָּכְרִיּוֹת ׃
vulg: et nunc date confessionem Domino Deo patrum vestrorum et facite placitum eius et separamini a populis terrae et ab uxoribus alienigenis
clem: Et nunc date confessionem Domino Deo patrum vestrorum, et facite placitum ejus, et separamini a populis terr, et ab uxoribus alienigenis.
kjv: Now therefore make confession unto the Lord God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.

wlc: וַיַּעְנוּ כָל־הַקָּהָל וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוֹל גָּדוֹל כֵּן כְּדִבְרֶיךָ עָלֵינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת ׃
vulg: et respondit universa multitudo dixitque voce magna iuxta verbum tuum ad nos sic fiat
clem: Et respondit universa multitudo, dixitque voce magna: Juxta verbum tuum ad nos, sic fiat.
kjv: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.

wlc: אֲבָל הָעָם רָב וְהָעֵת גְּשָׁמִים וְאֵין כֹּחַ לַעֲמוֹד בַּחוּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָה לֹא־לְיוֹם אֶחָד וְלֹא לִשְׁנַיִם כִּי־הִרְבִּינוּ לִפְשֹׁעַ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה ׃
vulg: verumtamen quia populus multus est et tempus pluviae et non sustinemus stare foris et opus non est diei unius vel duorum vehementer quippe peccavimus in sermone isto
clem: Verumtamen quia populus multus est, et tempus pluvi, et non sustinemus stare foris, et opus non est diei unius vel duorum (vehementer quippe peccavimus in sermone isto),
kjv: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

wlc: יַעֲמְדוּ־נָא שָׂרֵינוּ לְכָל־הַקָּהָל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בֶּעָרֵינוּ הַהֹשִׁיב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת יָבֹא לְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים וְעִמָּהֶם זִקְנֵי־עִיר וָעִיר וְשֹׁפְטֶיהָ עַד לְהָשִׁיב חֲרוֹן אַף־אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה ׃ פ
vulg: constituantur principes in universa multitudine et omnes in civitatibus nostris qui duxerunt uxores alienigenas veniant in temporibus statutis et cum his seniores per civitatem et civitatem et iudices eius donec avertatur ira Dei nostri a nobis super peccato hoc
clem: constituantur principes in universa multitudine: et omnes in civitatibus nostris qui duxerunt uxores alienigenas veniant in temporibus statutis, et cum his seniores per civitatem et civitatem, et judices ejus, donec avertatur ira Dei nostri a nobis super peccato hoc.
kjv: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.

wlc: אַךְ יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־עֲשָׂהאֵל וְיַחְזְיָה בֶן־תִּקְוָה עָמְדוּ עַל־זֹאת וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְשַׁבְּתַי הַלֵּוִי עֲזָרֻם ׃
vulg: igitur Ionathan filius Asahel et Iaazia filius Thecuae steterunt super hoc et Mesollam et Sebethai Levites adiuverunt eos
clem: Igitur Jonathan filius Azahel, et Jaasia filius Thecue, steterunt super hoc, et Messollam et Sebethai Levites adjuverunt eos:
kjv: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

wlc: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה וַיִּבָּדְלוּ עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וְכֻלָּם בְּשֵׁמוֹת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי לְדַרְיוֹשׁ הַדָּבָר ׃
vulg: feceruntque sic filii transmigrationis et abierunt Ezras sacerdos et viri principes familiarum in domum patrum suorum et omnes per nomina sua et sederunt in die primo mensis decimi ut quaererent rem
clem: feceruntque sic filii transmigrationis. Et abierunt Esdras sacerdos, et viri principes familiarum, in domos patrum suorum, et omnes per nomina sua, et sederunt in die primo mensis decimi ut qurerent rem.
kjv: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

wlc: וַיְכַלּוּ בַכֹּל אֲנָשִׁים הַהֹשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת עַד יוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן ׃ פ
vulg: et consummati sunt omnes viri qui duxerant uxores alienigenas usque ad diem primam mensis primi
clem: Et consummati sunt omnes viri, qui duxerant uxores alienigenas, usque ad diem primam mensis primi.
kjv: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

wlc: וַיִּמָּצֵא מִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הֹשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת מִבְּנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו מַעֲשֵׂיָה וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר וְיָרִיב וּגְדַלְיָה ׃
vulg: et inventi sunt de filiis sacerdotum qui duxerant uxores alienigenas de filiis Iosue filii Iosedech et fratres eius Maasia et Eliezer et Iarib et Godolia
clem: Et inventi sunt de filiis sacerdotum qui duxerant uxores alienigenas. De filiis Josue filii Josedec, et fratres ejus, Maasia, et Eliezer, et Jarib, et Godolia.
kjv: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

wlc: וַיִּתְּנוּ יָדָם לְהוֹצִיא נְשֵׁיהֶם וַאֲשֵׁמִים אֵיל־צֹאן עַל־אַשְׁמָתָם ׃ ס
vulg: et dederunt manus suas ut eicerent uxores suas et pro delicto suo arietem de ovibus offerrent
clem: Et dederunt manus suas ut ejicerent uxores suas, et pro delicto suo arietem de ovibus offerrent.
kjv: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי אִמֵּר חֲנָנִי וּזְבַדְיָה ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Emmer Anani et Zebedia
clem: Et de filiis Emmer, Hanani, et Zebedia.
kjv: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי חָרִם מַעֲשֵׂיָה וְאֵלִיָּה וּשְׁמַעְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעֻזִיָּה ׃
vulg: et de filiis Erim Masia et Helia et Semeia et Hiehihel et Ozias
clem: Et de filiis Harim, Maasia, et Elia, et Semeia, et Jehiel, et Ozias.
kjv: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּשְׁחוּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי מַעֲשֵׂיָה יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְתַנְאֵל יוֹזָבָד וְאֶלְעָשָׂה ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Phessur Helioenai Maasia Ismahel Nathanahel Iozabeth et Elasa
clem: Et de filiis Pheshur, Elionai, Maasia, Ismal, Nathanal, Jozabed, et Elasa.
kjv: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

wlc: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם יוֹזָבָד וְשִׁמְעִי וְקֵלָיָה הוּא קְלִיטָא פְּתַחְיָה יְהוּדָה וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Levitarum Iozabeth et Semei et Celaia ipse est Calita Phataia Iuda et Eliezer
clem: Et de filiis Levitarum, Jozabed, et Semei, et Celaia, ipse est Calita, Phataia, Juda, et Eliezer.
kjv: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

wlc: וּמִן־הַמְשֹׁרְרִים אֶלְיָשִׁיב וּמִן־הַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלֻּם וָטֶלֶם וְאוּרִי ׃
vulg: et de cantoribus Eliasub et de ianitoribus Sellum et Telem et Uri
clem: Et de cantoribus, Eliasib. Et de janitoribus, Sellum, et Telem, et Uri.
kjv: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

wlc: ס וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ רַמְיָה וְיִזִּיָּה וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּמִיָּמִן וְאֶלְעָזָר וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּבְנָיָה ׃ ס
vulg: et ex Israhel de filiis Pharos Remia et Ezia et Melchia et Miamin et Eliezer et Melchia et Banea
clem: Et ex Isral, de filiis Pharos, Remeia, et Jesia, et Melchia, et Miamin, et Eliezer, et Melchia, et Banea.
kjv: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי עֵילָם מַתַּנְיָה זְכַרְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעַבְדִּי וִירֵמוֹת וְאֵלִיָּה ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Helam Mathania Zaccharias et Hiehil et Abdi et Irimoth et Helia
clem: Et de filiis lam, Mathania, Zacharias, et Jehiel, et Abdi, et Jerimoth, et Elia.
kjv: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי זַתּוּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַי אֶלְיָשִׁיב מַתַּנְיָה וִירֵמוֹת וְזָבָד וַעֲזִיזָא ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Zethua Helioenai Eliasib Mathania et Ierimuth et Zabeth et Aziza
clem: Et de filiis Zethua, Elionai, Eliasib, Mathania, et Jerimuth, et Zabad, et Aziza.
kjv: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי בֵּבָי יְהוֹחָנָן חֲנַנְיָה זַבַּי עַתְלָי ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Bebai Iohanan Anania Zabbai Athalai
clem: Et de filiis Bebai, Johanan, Hanania, Zabbai, Athalai.
kjv: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי בָּנִי מְשֻׁלָּם מַלּוּךְ וַעֲדָיָה יָשׁוּב וּשְׁאָל יְרֵמוֹת ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Bani Mosollam et Melluch et Adaia Iasub et Saal et Ramoth
clem: Et de filiis Bani, Mosollam, et Melluch, et Adaia, Jasub, et Saal, et Ramoth.
kjv: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב עַדְנָא וּכְלָל בְּנָיָה מַעֲשֵׂיָה מַתַּנְיָה בְצַלְאֵל וּבִנּוּי וּמְנַשֶּׁה ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis Phaethmoab Edna et Chalal Banaias Maasias Mathanias Beselehel et Bennui et Manasse
clem: Et de filiis Phahath Moab, Edna, et Chalal, Banaias, et Maasias, Mathanias, Beseleel, Bennui, et Manasse.
kjv: And of the sons of Pahathmoab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

wlc: וּבְנֵי חָרִם אֱלִיעֶזֶר יִשִּׁיָּה מַלְכִּיָּה שְׁמַעְיָה שִׁמְעוֹן ׃
vulg: et de filiis Erem Eliezer Iesue Melchias Semeias Symeon
clem: Et de filiis Herem, Eliezer, Josue, Melchias, Semeias, Simeon,
kjv: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

wlc: בִּנְיָמִן מַלּוּךְ שְׁמַרְיָה ׃ ס
vulg: Beniamin Maloch Samarias
clem: Benjamin, Maloch, Samarias.
kjv: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

wlc: מִבְּנֵי חָשֻׁם מַתְּנַי מַתַּתָּה זָבָד אֱלִיפֶלֶט יְרֵמַי מְנַשֶּׁה שִׁמְעִי ׃ ס
vulg: de filiis Asom Matthanai Matthetha Zabed Elipheleth Iermai Manasse Semei
clem: Et de filiis Hasom, Mathanai, Mathatha, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jermai, Manasse, Semei.
kjv: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

wlc: מִבְּנֵי בָנִי מַעֲדַי עַמְרָם וְאוּאֵל ׃ ס
vulg: de filiis Bani Maaddi Amram et Huhel
clem: De filiis Bani, Maadi, Amram, et Vel,
kjv: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

wlc: בְּנָיָה בֵדְיָה כְּלָהַי ׃
vulg: Baneas et Badaias Cheiliau
clem: Baneas, et Badaias, Cheliau,
kjv: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

wlc: וַנְיָה מְרֵמוֹת אֶלְיָשִׁיב ׃
vulg: Vannia Marimuth et Eliasib
clem: Vania, Marimuth, et Eliasib,
kjv: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

wlc: מַתַּנְיָה מַתְּנַי וְיַעֲשׂוֹ ׃
vulg: Matthanias Mathanai et Iasi
clem: Mathanias, Mathanai, et Jasi,
kjv: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

wlc: וּבָנִי וּבִנּוּי שִׁמְעִי ׃
vulg: et Bani et Bennui Semei
clem: et Bani, et Bennui, Semei,
kjv: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

wlc: וְשֶׁלֶמְיָה וְנָתָן וַעֲדָיָה ׃
vulg: et Salmias et Nathan et Adaias
clem: et Salmias, et Nathan, et Adaias,
kjv: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

wlc: מַכְנַדְבַי שָׁשַׁי שָׁרָי ׃
vulg: Mechnedabai Sisai Sarai
clem: et Mechnedebai, Sisai, Sarai,
kjv: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

wlc: עֲזַרְאֵל וְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ שְׁמַרְיָה ׃
vulg: Ezrel et Selemau Semeria
clem: Ezrel, et Selemiau, Semeria,
kjv: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

wlc: שַׁלּוּם אֲמַרְיָה יוֹסֵף ׃ ס
vulg: Sellum Amaria Ioseph
clem: Sellum, Amaria, Joseph.
kjv: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

wlc: מִבְּנֵי נְבוֹ יְעִיאֵל מַתִּתְיָה זָבָד זְבִינָא יַדּוֹ וְיוֹאֵל בְּנָיָה ׃
vulg: de filiis Nebu Iaihel Matthathias Zabed Zabina Ieddu et Iohel Banaia
clem: De filiis Nebo, Jehiel, Mathathias, Zabad, Zabina, Jeddu, et Jol, et Banaia.
kjv: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.

wlc: כָּל־אֵלֶּה נָשְׂאוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת וְיֵשׁ מֵהֶם נָשִׁים וַיָּשִׂימוּ בָּנִים ׃ פ
vulg: omnes hii acceperunt uxores alienigenas et fuerunt ex eis mulieres quae pepererant filios
clem: Omnes hi acceperant uxores alienigenas, et fuerunt ex eis mulieres, qu pepererant filios.
kjv: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
